question: Who among the following became the first film star of India to roll out his NFT (Non-Fungible tokens) collection in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabh Bachchan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitabh Bachchan** became the first film star of India to roll out his **NFT (Non-Fungible Tokens) collection in 2021.**
 
• **Non-fungible tokens (NFTs) **are unique digital assets verified using blockchain technology.
 
• Amitabh Bachchan's NFT collection included autographed vintage posters of his movies, verses from his father's poems, and more.
 
• The launch of his NFT collection marked a significant milestone in the Indian entertainment industry, embracing the digital and crypto revolution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs)** are digital files that represent ownership of unique items or content, such as art, music, and videos.
 
• Unlike cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, NFTs are not interchangeable with each other, making them unique.
 
• NFTs have gained popularity as a way for artists and celebrities to monetize their digital creations and connect with fans.
 
• The blockchain technology behind NFTs ensures the authenticity and provenance of digital assets.
